title: dichanthelium trifolium
intro: Dichanthelium trifolium, commonly known as Poverty Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dichanthelium trifolium include calming the nervous system, reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
